units.source_text: 柏木说这番话时，微妙地活动着自己的手，

en.t: As Kashiwagi said this, he moved his hands with delicate precision,

units.source_text: 把生锈的小"剑山"排在水盘中，

en.t: arranging the small rusty kenzan in the water basin,

units.source_text: 然后将挺秀的木贼草插在上面，

en.t: then inserting the tall, elegant horsetail reeds into them,

units.source_text: 再配以修剪为由三瓣叶衬托的燕子花，

en.t: and adding irises set off by three trimmed leaves,

units.source_text: 逐渐造成现水型插花的形状。

en.t: gradually forming the shape of a gensui-style flower arrangement.

units.source_text: 水盘旁边还堆放着许多洗净了的白色和褐色的洁净的细砂子，

en.t: Beside the water basin, many clean grains of white and brown sand, already washed, were also piled up,
ready to be used for the final finishing touches.
